    level="1"

>
[Awakened Stride](/Feats.aspx?ID=5319) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 27

**Prerequisites**
[Wild Stride](/Feats.aspx?ID=5313)

</column>

---

You blend your instinct and intellect to move so fast you seem to be a blur. When you use Wild Stride, you can Stride three times, and you're [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) during the movement.
name: Awakened Stride
